Definition: from Θεσσαλός (a Thessalian) and G3529; Thessalonice, a place in Macedonia:--Thessalonica.
BiblicalUsage: Thessalonica is the chief city of Macedonia, where Paul preached and a church was planted. In Acts 17:1, they came to Thessalonica. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Thessalonica reminds me Scripture happened somewhere, not in the abstract.
